data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Nadima means 'delight' or 'pleasure'. It is derived from the root 'dama', which connotes a sense of joy, satisfaction, and happiness. In Islamic tradition, the name Nadima is believed to symbolize the inner peace and contentment that comes from living in accordance with Allah's will. The name Nadima carries the meaning “Delight, Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nadima usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
